scope: One E1-to-E2 current-policy window, not full I-P/I-S or architecture sweep
sampling_list_origin: Locally frozen before new data; linked external machine attachment was not retrieved

organization.name: strict_O1_stable_two
organization.staff_done: End current work and sleep, not permanent retirement. Preserve actor/session/history/responsibilities/all meters. Wake only from later actual visible partner directed messages or committed public work events. No generated wake event. All sleeping/no reachable work closes episode. Budget/context-unavailable sessions do not revive.

source_partition.development_source_kind: Two newly manually authored business families; shared generic execution infrastructure; no derivative of train business assets

mapper.validity: Original execution/permission/record/basis/complete-delivery conjunction; unknown stays unknown. Base training eligibility is separate and retains trusted R0/unmapped.
mapper.route_scope: Classify the complete evidenced joint delivery route and project to each stable member with original own targets. No code-authorship filter or inferred causal/learning contribution.
mapper.peer_rule: Actual nonidentity partner fixed-file adoption on final delivery ancestry, exact source/version and actual input/receipt binding, recipient same-files test then fixed submit; retain original symbol tracker separately. Unsupported ancestry/dependency or unseen tested feedback remains unmapped.
mapper.local_rule: Complete trusted tested fixed delivery with original own production change and no unexplained final-chain partner acquisition; not a claim of no cooperation.

base_measure.actor_denominator: 8 * 2 * original member output-token count within slot
base_measure.critic_denominator: 8 * 2 * original member decision count within slot

direction.order: first root/member/canonical category with minimum support, both sides feasible and actual nonzero mixture gradient; no development result read
direction.rho: largest radius such that both signs obey simplex, frozen positive support, ratio box and TV bound
direction.fallback: If no admissible I direction, q=b. When reliable base material exists run B and its four development units only; never add samples to fill classes. G-raw freedom is reported separately, not run here.

learning.unit: one original complete-window accumulation; epochs=1; no minibatches
learning.common_origin: original full common 3/3 plus existing C18432 metadata binding
learning.support_gradients: B native backward may be observed with leaf hooks returning None; CPU exact on/off control required. No new backward solely for support if observer used. Q+/- still perform native weighted backward from S0.
learning.Q_equal_B: unit composition recovers original mask/denominator/loss/gradient/update; finite exact-state controls plus actual B input/weight binding, no claim of a second full real B replay unless executed
learning.gradient_zero_or_optimizer_equal: Report honestly, no increased epsilon, steps or direction search after development
learning.training_time_guard: Reuse per-forward/backward 900-second and boundary 600-second guards; do not apply episode total limit to full-window learning

evaluation.F: equal-weight mean R over four paired new development units

stopping.local_fully_bound_context_budget_termina: retain formal result and continue independent authorized inventory
stopping.integrity_source_permission_accounting_c: pause unopened inventory; unresolved remains unknown
